html_title: Vaduganathan et al. 2022 — SGLT2 HF Meta-analysis SEA
source_warnings: The evaluated PDF states that a corrected online version first appeared January 12, 2023; publication remains Lancet 2022.
The printed reference list skips reference number 18 (numbering runs 1–17, then 19–26); the reference Markdown preserves the source numbering.
Safety-event definitions and capture windows differ between DELIVER and EMPEROR-Preserved, and the source explicitly did not directly compare or meta-analyse these safety events.
The five-trial meta-analysis is supportive/post hoc and had no assigned alpha; it should not be treated as the same inferential layer as the prespecified DELIVER + EMPEROR-Preserved analysis.
